content: प्ररोचन {%a.%} Exciting or enticing. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Exciting, or stimulating. .²2 Illustration, explanation. .²3 Seduction. .²4 Exhibition (of a person) for being seen and liked (by the people); अलोकसामान्यगुणस्तनूजः प्ररोचनार्थं प्रकटीकृतश्च <ls>Māl. 1. 10</ls> (where Jagaddhara interprets प्ररोचनार्थम् by प्रवृत्तिपाटवार्थम् ‘in order to be thoroughly acquainted with the world’). .²5 Favourable description of that which is to follow in a play. .²6 Representation of the end as all but accomplished; see <ls>S. D. 388</ls> (प्ररोचना also in the last two senses; प्ररोचना तु विज्ञेया संहारार्थप्रदर्शिनी <ls>S. D. 396</ls>).
